nodes.text:
🚨 A new case of human metapneumovirus (HMPV) has been reported in Puducherry, raising India's total to 18 cases, all involving children. 

The patient is responding well to treatment at JIPMER. 

Health authorities are intensifying precautions nationwide. #HMPV #healthupdates
